lines.en: label beachseventouka1:
scene toukayasubeachfight1
SO DRAW ME {s}IN TO{/s} INTO YOU.
lines.zh: 那就把我拉{s}进到{/s}进你体内吧。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight2
: Touka?...
lines.zh: : Touka？……

lines.en: : Will you...talk to me now?
lines.zh: : 你……现在愿意跟我说话了吗？

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight3
: {i}Please?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}求你了？{/i}

lines.en: These words, that once would have cut like a knife, had dulled and pressed upon the skin of Touka Tsukioka hard enough to bruise her.
lines.zh: 这些话曾经锋利如刀，如今已经钝了，却仍重重压在 Touka Tsukioka 的皮肤上，足以留下淤青。

lines.en: The secrets that spilled all over the cell the night Yasu was claimed clung to her when she returned home shortly after. And it took little more than a glance to expose them for what they really were.
lines.zh: Yasu 被占有的那晚洒满整个牢房的那些秘密，在她回家后不久便黏在了她身上。而只需一眼，就能看出它们的真面目。

lines.en: Misguided betrayal. Reckless naiveté. Orbs of repressed vitriol that hovered over two separate souls like halos, incessantly reminding her of the chaos that exists outside of her bubble.
lines.zh: 被误导的背叛。鲁莽的天真。还有被压抑的怨毒凝成的球，像光环一样悬在两个不同的灵魂上方，不停地提醒她：在她的泡泡之外，混乱一直都存在。

lines.en: Silence was easier than anger, though.
lines.zh: 不过，沉默比愤怒来得容易。

lines.en: So Touka had her own share of secrets now. Or at least little thoughts she could fashion into them to distract her from the jagged, whispery voice pouring from an angel’s cocoon.
lines.zh: 所以 Touka 现在也有了她自己的那份秘密。或者至少是一些她可以加工成秘密的小心思，好让自己不去听那个从天使的茧里流出来的、沙哑低语的声音。

lines.en: If only metamorphosis came easy. Then each of them could fly away.
lines.zh: 要是蜕变能来得容易些就好了。那样她们每个人都能飞走。

lines.en: : Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka——

lines.en: : Did I not tell you to leave me alone, Yasu? Go have fun with the other girls. I will not be your babysitter this weekend.
lines.zh: : 我不是叫你别管我吗，Yasu？去跟别的女孩玩吧。这个周末我不会当你的保姆。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight4
: But I don’t want to be with the other girls right now. And you’ve barely said anything to me all week.
lines.zh: : 可我现在不想跟别的女孩在一起。而且你这一整周几乎都没跟我说过话。

lines.en: : Can we at least swim in the same water?
lines.zh: : 我们至少能在同一片水里游泳吗？

lines.en: : I am in no mood to {i}swim,{/i} Yasu.
lines.zh: : 我没有心情{i}游泳{/i}，Yasu。

lines.en: : You’re in no mood to do {i}anything.{/i} All you do now is just sit around and look angry. And your blood is so loud I’m afraid it will rip you in two.
lines.zh: : 你什么{i}事{/i}都没心情做。你现在成天就是坐着、一脸生气。而且你的血吵得我生怕它会把你撕成两半。

lines.en: : Then you best close the door behind you so you’re not covered in it when I {i}do{/i} explode. Bye-bye now.
lines.zh: : 那你最好随手把门带上，这样等我{i}真的{/i}炸开的时候，就不会溅你一身。拜拜了您呐。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight5
: No! Stop doing that! It’s not fair if I’m the only one ever being looked out for!
lines.zh: : 不要！别这样！如果永远只有我被照顾，那不公平！

lines.en: : Through His teachings, I have learned that in times of crisis, even the most lost of lambs can still find their way back. And I know it is not a fitting role, but I would like to play the shepherd this time so you can-
lines.zh: : 通过祂的教诲，我明白了在危难时刻，即便是最迷途的羔羊也仍能找回归途。我知道这不太适合我，但这次我想当一回牧羊人，好让你——

lines.en: : I don’t care about your stupid god. I don’t care about what you {i}think{/i} he {i}teaches{/i} you. And I {i}definitely{/i} don’t care to have {i}you{/i} of all people try to reach out and help me right now.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎你那个愚蠢的神。我不在乎你{i}以为{/i}祂{i}教{/i}了你什么。而且我{i}绝对{/i}不需要——尤其是{i}你{/i}——在这时候跑来伸手帮我。

lines.en: : Touka! That’s-
lines.zh: : Touka！那太——

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight6
: I am {i}trying{/i} to do the right thing and not talk rudely to you as I know this is not entirely your fault...
lines.zh: : 我{i}正在努力{/i}做正确的事，尽量不对你说难听的话，因为我知道这不全是你一个人的错……

lines.en: : But unfortunately, that means I must not talk to you {i}at all{/i} for a little while because my self-control only goes so far.
lines.zh: : 但不幸的是，这意味着我必须{i}暂时{/i}完全不跟你说话，因为我的自制力也就只有那么点。

lines.en: : Now, close the door and go. Surely there’s someone else for you to share the water with.
lines.zh: : 现在，把门带上，走吧。肯定还有别人可以陪你一起泡水。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight7
: I don’t {i}want{/i} to share it with anyone else, though. The two of us almost always enjoy the beach trip together. Why would it be any different this time?
lines.zh: : 可我{i}不想{/i}跟别人一起。我们俩几乎每次都是一起享受这趟海滩之旅的。为什么这次会不一样？

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight8
: Why would it- are you fucking kidding me right now?
lines.zh: : 为什么这次会——你他妈在开玩笑吧？

lines.en: : Please don’t curse. You of all people shouldn’t dirty yourself with such little sins.
lines.zh: : 请不要说脏话。你这样的人最不该为这种小小的罪而弄脏自己。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight9

: Fuck your “sins” and fuck your idea of what is “clean” and fuck your fucking outlook on fucking curse words! I’m telling you one last time to leave me alone! I do not want to {i}be around{/i} you, Yasu. {i}At all.{/i}
lines.zh: : 去你妈的「罪」，去你妈的「洁净」标准，去你妈的对脏话的操蛋看法！我最后再说一次，别管我！我{i}一点都不想{/i}跟你待在一起，Yasu。

lines.en: : What happened to make you act this way toward me?...
lines.zh: : 到底发生了什么，让你这样对我？……

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight10
: Oh, stop pretending to be an idiot. Surely you’re competent enough to know when and how all of this started.
lines.zh: : 哦，别装傻了。你总该有本事知道这一切是从什么时候、怎么开始的吧。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight11
: Is everything okay, you two? Should Molly and I step out?
lines.zh: : 你们俩还好吗？要我和 Molly 出去避一下吗？

lines.en: : Yes, please. And take Yasu with you so I can call the front desk and ask them how much longer it will be until my room is ready.
lines.zh: : 好的，麻烦了。把 Yasu 也带走，我好给前台打电话，问我的房间还要多久才好。

lines.en: : I brought a bunch of new manga, Yasu. I even separated them based on how sinful they are so you can pick and choose from what I will now refer to as the “purity pile.”
lines.zh: : Yasu，我带了一大堆新漫画。我甚至按「有多罪恶」给它们分了类，你可以从我称之为「纯洁堆」的地方挑。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight12
: That is very thoughtful and it sounds very fun, but I need to talk to Touka and I can’t figure out how to do it without making her angrier.
lines.zh: : 你想得真周到，听起来也很有意思，但我得跟 Touka 谈谈，而且我不知道怎么做才不会让她更生气。

lines.en: : A good start would have been attempting to do so {i}without{/i} spectators. Just as a reference point in the future.
lines.zh: : 一个不错的开头是：试着{i}不要{/i}在观众面前谈。这点供你以后参考。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight13
: I {i}did{/i} try that! Over and over and over again! But you’re just as cold when I do that as you are right now! And you’re the type of girl who {i}normally{/i} burns like the sun!
lines.zh: : 我{i}试过{/i}了！一次一次又一次！可就算那样，你也跟现在一样冷！而你{i}平时{/i}可是像太阳一样燃烧的女孩啊！

lines.en: : If something is wrong, Touka, you must tell me! Lest your essence be corrupted and send you spiraling halfway down the-
lines.zh: : 如果有什么不对劲，Touka，你一定要告诉我！免得你的本质被腐蚀，让你一路螺旋着坠落——

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight14
: Can you stop playing dumb and speak to me like a normal fucking girl if you want to talk?!
lines.zh: : 你要是想谈，能不能别再装傻，像个正常的他妈的女孩那样跟我说话？！

lines.en: : In fact, what good do you think talking is even {i}going{/i} to do when all of my words will be inevitably filtered through some fucking ancient codex anyway?! You don’t actually {i}hear{/i} me! You don’t {i}listen!{/i}
lines.zh: : 事实上，既然我说的每一句话都必然会被某本操蛋的古老经卷过滤一遍，你觉得谈话{i}还有{/i}什么用？！你根本没有真的{i}听见{/i}我！你根本{i}没有在听{/i}！

lines.en: : You sit there every fucking day, wide-eyed and aloof! Often in the {i}wrong{/i} direction! And all I say goes in one ear and out the other!
lines.zh: : 你每天都他妈坐在那儿，瞪着大眼睛、神游天外！还经常朝着{i}错的{/i}方向！我说的话全都是左耳进右耳出！

lines.en: : What exists between them, I have no idea! But it clearly isn’t a brain if you can’t even comprehend what “go away” means!
lines.zh: : 那两只耳朵之间到底装着什么，我完全不知道！但如果连「走开」是什么意思都理解不了，那显然不是大脑！

lines.en: : Why are you being so mean?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么要这么刻薄？……

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight15
: Hah! {i}Why am I being so-{/i} I don’t know, Yasu. I really don’t.
lines.zh: : 哈！{i}我为什么这么——{/i}我不知道，Yasu。我真的不知道。

lines.en: : Perhaps I should strip down and lock myself in a musty jail cell to repent for my actions on my fucking knees since that’s what your {i}religion{/i} would likely have me do.
lines.zh: : 也许我该脱光衣服，把自己锁进一间发霉的牢房，跪在他妈的地上为我的行为忏悔——毕竟你那{i}宗教{/i}大概就是这么要求我的。

lines.en: : So...that {i}is{/i} what has caused you such great pain then.
lines.zh: : 所以……让你这么痛苦的，{i}果然{/i}是这件事。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight16
: Oh, what a fucking {i}genius{/i} you are! Excellent job, Yasu! You finally figured it out!
lines.zh: : 哦，你可真是个他妈的{i}天才{/i}！干得漂亮，Yasu！你终于想明白了！

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight17
: Okay, yeah. I think we should probably go.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。我觉得我们大概该走了。

lines.en: : Uhh...just come find us in the common room if you want to check out the purity pile, Yasu. I can almost guarantee it isn’t going anywhere.
lines.zh: : 呃……Yasu，你要是想看「纯洁堆」，就去公共休息室找我们。我几乎可以保证它不会跑掉。

lines.en: : Why didn’t you just say something, Touka?! You {i}know{/i} our beliefs don’t align! I don’t understand what it is that you’re not okay with when it’s often the complete opposite from what I-
lines.zh: : 你为什么就不肯直说呢，Touka？！你{i}明明知道{/i}我们的信仰不一样！我不明白你到底是对什么不满——毕竟我的想法常常跟你完全相反——

lines.en: : NO ONE IN THE FUCKING {i}WORLD{/i} IS “OKAY” WITH THE THINGS YOU ARE, YASU! JUST FUCKING ADAPT, ALREADY! {i}I{/i} DID! DO YOU NOT REMEMBER THAT THIS WORLD IS NEW FOR ME TOO?!
lines.zh: : 这个操蛋的{i}世界{/i}上没有一个人能对这些事「不在意」，YASU！你他妈就快点适应吧！{i}我{/i}就适应了！你难道不记得，这个世界对我来说也是全新的吗？！

lines.en: : But you’re strong! And I’m just-
lines.zh: : 可你很坚强啊！而我只——

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight18
: Does this look like “strong” to you?! Do you think I’m adequately holding things together right now?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得我这副样子叫「坚强」吗？！你觉得我现在有把一切好好撑住吗？！

lines.en: : Or am I perhaps a little pissed off that you’d give away your fucking {i}purity{/i} so easily?! Over a fucking {i}nightmare,{/i} no less!
lines.zh: : 还是说，我其实只是有点火大——你居然那么轻易就把你那操蛋的{i}贞洁{/i}交出去了？！而且还是因为一个操蛋的{i}噩梦{/i}！

lines.en: : Okay. Time to go, Molly.
lines.zh: : 好了。该走了，Molly。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight19
: I taught you better than this. Mother {i}and{/i} I taught you better than this. But, like always, you heard absolutely fucking {i}nothing.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我教过你不能这样。母亲{i}和{/i}我都教过你不能这样。但跟往常一样，你他妈{i}一个字{/i}都没听进去。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Now it’s just like you’re back at the fucking doctor’s office, letting people take advantage of you all over again! If only you listened to those who care about you even {i}half{/i} as much as you listen to all those fucking “voices!”{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}现在就像是你又回到了那间操蛋的诊所，再一次任人占你便宜！你要是能像听那些操蛋的「声音」那样，哪怕只{i}分一半{/i}的心思去听关心你的人说话就好了！{/size}

lines.en: : I {i}had{/i} to do it, Touka! You don’t understand! But I’m safe now! And I don’t need to do it anymore! I don’t need to-
lines.zh: : 我{i}必须{/i}那么做，Touka！你不明白！但我现在安全了！我再也不需要那么做了！我不需要——

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight20
: Oh, good! No worries at all then! What great news!
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了！那就完全不用担心了！真是个好消息！

lines.en: : R...Really? I-
lines.zh: : 真……真的吗？我——

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight21
: NO, YOU FUCKING DUNCE! IT’S NOT GREAT! IT WILL NEVER {i}BE{/i} GREAT! YOU LOST YOUR VIRGINITY TO A TEACHER IN THE BASEMENT OF A FUCKING CHURCH AFTER LITERALLY {i}BEGGING{/i} FOR IT!
lines.zh: : 不，你这个蠢货！这他妈一点都不好！它永远都不会{i}好{/i}！你把处女身给了一个老师，地点是一间操蛋教堂的地下室，而且你还是字面意义上{i}求着{/i}他干的！

lines.en: : There are over ten thousand fucking religions in this world and not a single ONE OF THEM beside yours would endorse such a thing! Take a fucking second to think about {i}that,{/i} Yasu!
lines.zh: : 这个世界上有超过一万种操蛋的宗教，除了你那个之外，{i}没有一种{/i}会认可这种事！你他妈花一秒钟想想{i}这个{/i}，Yasu！

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight22
: But you want to do the same thing! You want to receive Sensei’s light too! So why is it only bad for {i}me?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 可你也想做同样的事啊！你也想得到老师的光啊！那为什么只有{i}我{/i}做就是错的？！

lines.en: : What would have been the {i}right{/i} way to do it in your eyes?! Why haven’t you yelled at anyone else?!
lines.zh: : 在你眼里，怎样才算{i}正确{/i}的做法？！为什么你没冲别人吼？！

lines.en: : BECAUSE YOU’RE SUPPOSED TO BE MY BEST FRIEND! Did you really think you could do something like this and I’d just shrug it off like it’s no big deal?! {i}I{/i} haven’t even slept with him yet!
lines.zh: : 因为你本该是我最好的朋友！你真的以为你做了这种事，我会耸耸肩当没事吗？！{i}我{/i}都还没跟他上床呢！

lines.en: : Okay, but {i}I{/i} have! And just because we’re friends doesn’t mean you get to tell me what I’m allowed to do with my body! It’s still {i}mine!{/i}
lines.zh: : 好吧，但{i}我{/i}上了！而且就算我们是朋友，也不代表你有权规定我能拿自己的身体做什么！它仍然是{i}我的{/i}！

lines.en: : Sensei took very good care of me. And I-
lines.zh: : 老师把我照顾得很好。而且我——

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight23
: He {i}took care{/i} of you. Oh, great. That’s just great. I absolutely {i}love{/i} all of the things that could possibly mean. What a wonderful thing to hear.
lines.zh: : 他{i}照顾{/i}了你。哦，真好。真是太好了。我简直{i}爱死{/i}了它可能包含的所有意思。听到这话真是太美妙了。

lines.en: : I don’t regret it one bit...I’m safer now. And we aren’t in love, so you don’t need to feel the sort of pressure commonly associated with adultery! You can still sleep with him and I’ll be {i}happy{/i} for you!
lines.zh: : 我一点也不后悔……我现在更安全了。而且我们又没有相爱，所以你不必承受那种通常跟通奸联系在一起的压力！你还是可以跟他上床，我会为你{i}高兴{/i}的！

lines.en: : Thank you so much for your blessing, Yasu. That means just about as much to me as the ten paragraph passage you spoke at my bedside while I was trying to fall asleep last night.
lines.zh: : 多谢你的恩准，Yasu。这对我而言，差不多就等于昨晚我正要睡着时，你在我床边念的那段十段长的经文。

lines.en: : Those words mean {i}everything,{/i} though! They-
lines.zh: : 可那些话对我{i}意味着一切{/i}！它们——

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight24

: They mean nothing! {i}NOTHING!{/i} Your bible is NOTHING but a mess of nonsensical contradictory statements you pull out to justify {i}everything!{/i} But there’s no {i}meaning!{/i} It’s all just fanatical drivel!
lines.zh: : 它们什么都不是！{i}什么都不是{/i}！你的圣经{i}什么都不是{/i}，只是一堆自相矛盾的胡话，你随手掏出来为{i}任何事{/i}开脱！可里面{i}根本没有意义{/i}！全是狂热的胡说八道！

lines.en: : It’s not! It’s the truth!
lines.zh: : 不是的！那是真理！

lines.en: : Then tell me why you said just a moment ago that your body belongs to {i}you{/i} when I’ve heard a million times that it belongs to your fucking god! Which one is it, Yasu?!
lines.zh: : 那你告诉我，为什么你刚刚才说这具身体属于{i}你{/i}，而我已经听过一百万次说它属于你那个操蛋的神？！到底是哪个，Yasu？！

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight25
: It is both.
lines.zh: : 两者都是。

lines.en: : Yeah, of fucking course it is. How convenient.
lines.zh: : 是啊，他妈的当然是。真方便。

lines.en: : He gave me this body. And while it is {i}my{/i} body to do as I please with, that does not mean I mistrust what He would have me do with it.
lines.zh: : 祂给了我这具身体。虽然它是{i}我的{/i}，我可以随心所欲地处置，但这并不意味着我不信任祂要我怎么用它。

lines.en: : Mhm. And was He also the one who made you strip down for all those little “photo sessions” in the past?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那以前让你脱光去拍那些小小的「照片会」的，也是祂咯？

lines.en: : That was before I knew of Him.
lines.zh: : 那是在我认识祂之前。

lines.en: : But if He asked you to do them now, would you?
lines.zh: : 可如果是祂现在要你那么做，你会吗？

lines.en: : Yasu-
lines.zh: : Yasu——

lines.en: : I would.
lines.zh: : 我会。

lines.en: : I knew it...
lines.zh: : 我就知道……

lines.en: : Nothing about you is {i}yours.{/i} No girl would choose a place like that for one of the most important moments of her life. You’re just a puppet.
lines.zh: : 你身上没有一样东西是{i}属于你自己的{/i}。没有哪个女孩会选那种地方度过人生最重要的时刻之一。你只是个傀儡。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight26
: I’m not a puppet...
lines.zh: : 我不是傀儡……

lines.en: : Oh, perhaps just a worm then? A roach? What are all of those other terrible things “He Who Loves You So Much” forces you to call yourself? There are too many to recount right now.
lines.zh: : 哦，那也许是条虫？一只蟑螂？那个「如此爱你的祂」还逼你用什么难听的词称呼自己来着？太多了，一时数不过来。

lines.en: : A maggot, perhaps? A housefly? Oh! Why not go for something {i}truly{/i} exotic and call yourself a fucking vinegaroon while you’re at it?!
lines.zh: : 也许是蛆？家蝇？哦！干脆挑个{i}真正{/i}稀奇的，顺便把自己叫成他妈的鞭蝎得了？！

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight27
: Because I’m a {i}girl!{/i} I’m not a bug! I’m not a worm! I’m Yasu!
lines.zh: : 因为我是个{i}女孩{/i}！我不是虫子！我不是蠕虫！我是 Yasu！

lines.en: : I like shoujo manga and strawberry daifuku and swimming and {i}you!{/i} I like Sensei too! I’m not a puppet! I’m not an idiot! I’m just {i}me!{/i} And I can’t help it if I’m a little broken when I was born this way!
lines.zh: : 我喜欢少女漫画、草莓大福、游泳，还有{i}你{/i}！我也喜欢老师！我不是傀儡！我不是白痴！我就是{i}我自己{/i}！如果我生来如此、有点残缺，那也不是我能控制的！

lines.en: : You can’t say that God is leading me astray when you’re doing the same thing He is, though! You {i}both{/i} have ideas for what I’m supposed to be and how I’m supposed to act and I can’t follow {i}all{/i} of them!
lines.zh: : 可你不能一边说神在带我走歪路，一边做着和祂一样的事！你们{i}两个{/i}都对我该成为什么样、该怎么做事有自己的想法，而我没办法{i}全都{/i}照做！

lines.en: : So what {i}am{/i} I supposed to do, Touka?! Trust {i}your{/i} word over the one that’s been with me way longer?!
lines.zh: : 那我{i}到底{/i}该怎么办，Touka？！要我相信{i}你的{/i}话，而不是那个陪了我久得多的声音？！

lines.en: : Believe that {i}you{/i} are right and {i}He{/i} is wrong and wait until the world is over to do what everyone else is doing?!
lines.zh: : 要我相信{i}你{/i}是对的、{i}祂{/i}是错的，然后等到世界末日之后，再去做其他人都在做的事？！

lines.en: : I just want to {i}live!{/i} I want to keep experiencing these happy days for the first time in my life!
lines.zh: : 我只是想{i}活着{/i}！我想继续过这些开心的日子——我这辈子头一回有这种日子！

lines.en: : And I’m sorry if the choice {i}I{/i} made makes you sad or angry, but it was still {i}my{/i} choice at the end of the day! And I stand by it!
lines.zh: : 如果我{i}自己{/i}做的选择让你难过或生气，我很抱歉——但说到底那仍然是{i}我的{/i}选择！而我坚持它！

lines.en: : You {i}are{/i} an idiot, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 你{i}确实{/i}是个白痴，Yasu。

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight28
: You don’t even realize it’s {i}worse{/i} when the choice is truly yours.
lines.zh: : 你甚至没意识到，当选择真的是你自己做的，事情反而{i}更糟{/i}。

lines.en: : But...how?
lines.zh: : 可是……怎么会？

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} tell me. If you’re as human as you say you are, what other reasons might I have to be upset about you and Sensei crossing the line you did?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}来告诉我。如果你真像你说的那样是个人，那你和老师越过那条线，我还会因为别的什么理由而难过？

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight29
: It isn’t like that...
lines.zh: : 不是那样的……

lines.en: : I really just...
lines.zh: : 我真的只是……

lines.en: : It saved me. {i}He{/i} saved me.
lines.zh: : 它救了我。{i}他{/i}救了我。

lines.en: : You just keep making it worse, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你只是在让它越来越糟，是吧？

lines.en: : If it is an apology you want, I will get down on my knees and-
lines.zh: : 如果你想要的是道歉，我可以跪下来——

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight30
: Yasu, how would you like having the dorm room to yourself for a while?
lines.zh: : Yasu，你想不想自己独占宿舍房间一阵子？

lines.en: : ...What?
: Perhaps even indefinitely? I think it’s rather clear that Kumon-mi High isn’t going to work out as well for me as my mother had hoped.
lines.zh: : 也许是无限期？我觉得已经很明显了——Kumon-mi 高中对我来说，不会像我母亲希望的那样顺利。

lines.en: : You’re...leaving?
lines.zh: : 你要……走了？

lines.en: : I haven’t decided anything yet, but-
lines.zh: : 我还没决定任何事，不过——

lines.en: scene toukayasubeachfight31
: No. No, you can’t leave. Not now. The timing is wrong. Bad things will happen if you leave.
lines.zh: : 不。不，你不能走。不是现在。时机不对。你走了会有坏事发生。

lines.en: : Yasu-
lines.zh: : Yasu——

lines.en: : {i}I’ll{/i} leave. You can stay and I’ll go out on my own again. I’ve done it before. I can survive. I can-
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}走。你可以留下，我再一个人出去。我以前做过。我活得了。我能——

lines.en: : I’ve had enough of your {i}prophecies,{/i} okay? I don’t care how...accurate they are most of the time. My fate is decided by me and me alone. Not the things you hear and not the things you see.
lines.zh: : 我受够你的{i}预言{/i}了，好吗？我不在乎它们大多数时候有多准。我的命运由我一个人决定。不是你听到的那些东西，也不是你看到的那些东西。

lines.en: : This is what it means to be free. Not...whatever {i}you{/i} are.
lines.zh: : 这才是自由的意义。而不是……{i}你{/i}现在这副样子。

lines.en: : Touka...please...
lines.zh: : Touka……求你了……

lines.en: : Salvation doesn’t seem so great anymore, now does it?
lines.zh: : 救赎看起来没那么美好了，是吧？

lines.en: : {i}Please...{/i}
scene black
: I told you to leave me alone, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我说了让你别管我，不是吗？

lines.en: : Don’t go...
lines.zh: : 别走……

lines.en: : My words never mattered to you. It’s exactly as I said.
lines.zh: : 我的话对你从来都不算数。就跟我说的一样。

lines.en: : In {i}one{/i} ear...
lines.zh: : {i}一只{/i}耳朵进……

lines.en: : Out the other.
lines.zh: : 另一只耳朵出。

lines.en: : May your “end of days” be full of bliss.
lines.zh: : 愿你的「末日」充满至福。

lines.en: : And...may the...
lines.zh: : 还有……愿那……

lines.en: : May the path you walk...
lines.zh: : 愿你走的路……

lines.en: : Be free of callousness...
lines.zh: : 没有冷酷无情……

{i}Touka has dropped out!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Touka 退学了！{/i}
